lines.zh: 骨节在岩浆里一节节滑动。
lines.en: My bone segments slide through the lava.
I crawl along the lake floor.
My spine is longer than a boat.

lines.zh: 岩浆从我肋骨间漏下去。
lines.en: Lava drains between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我压过一块烧红的石头。
lines.en: I slide over a stone glowing red.

lines.zh: 我这么多节骨头一起往前推。
lines.en: All my bone joints push me forward together.

lines.zh: 我在暗红的湖面上留下一道沟。
lines.en: I leave a trench across the dark red lake.
The deeper I go, the warmer it gets.

lines.zh: 我绕着岩浆瀑布转上去。
lines.en: I coil up around the lava fall.

lines.zh: 骨头磨着骨头，响个不停。
lines.en: Bone grinds on bone without pause.
I pass through a patch of floating stone.
My tail tip sweeps up a line of fire.
The moon walks. So do I.
I walked this road before. Long ago.
My shadow outpaces me.
The smell of soil... like home.
click... who follows me?
My legs won't obey me.
Don't look back. You'll remember.
Counting steps. Lost count.
shadows... I can't go back.
This road leads to a grave.
Bones creak. Pay no mind.
Grass dies under my feet.
I coil in a ring beneath the lava.
Only a stretch of spine shows.
There is little to see in the fire.

lines.zh: 我听著远处凋灵骷髅的骨头响。
lines.en: I listen to wither skeletons rattling far off.
I have waited a very long time.
Heat shimmers over my bones.
There is only firelight in my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 岩浆冒了几个泡，又破了。
lines.en: A few lava bubbles rise and pop.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，也就不用抬头。
lines.en: I do not breathe, so I never surface.

lines.zh: 这层热皮底下什么都不长。
lines.en: Nothing grows under this hot crust.
What was I waiting for?
Someone crying? No.
My eyes ache, dry as dust.
Move now? Wait a bit.
This body is noisy.
I forget my own name.
I used to sit here alive.
Wind stopped. So did I.
Dawn changes nothing.

lines.zh: 活着的时候，我站得更直。
lines.en: I stood straighter when alive.
The smell of the living cuts through lava.

lines.zh: 你站在湖边，站得太久了。
lines.en: You stand at the shore far too long.

lines.zh: 你身上有主世界的凉气。
lines.en: You carry the cool air of the Overworld.

lines.zh: 你的铁甲在红光里发亮。
lines.en: Your iron armor glints in the red light.

lines.zh: 我看清了你落脚的那块石头。
lines.en: I see exactly which stone you stand on.
Did you come to pick up bones?
Do not back away; lava is behind you too.
Your heart is beating much too fast.
The hand holding your sword is not steady.
Your look is carved into my memory.
Will you stay?
You're standing on my grave.
The scent of you is strong.
You still carry warmth.
Do you know me?
I'm not hungry. Truly.
Leave the light on. I fear dark.
A living one. Still warm.

lines.zh: 好久没见过这么红的脸。
lines.en: Such warm cheeks. Rare these days.
Your eyes... may I borrow them?

lines.zh: 我的骨节被打松了一节。
lines.en: One of my joints got knocked loose.
A cracked bone will knit back.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我脊上，火星四溅。
lines.en: Your sword struck my spine and sparks flew.
I have no flesh, only echoes.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了几块骨。
lines.en: That cost me a few pieces of bone.
You cut off the tip of my tail.
Pain is only noise to me.

lines.zh: 我整条身子都震了一下。
lines.en: My whole length shuddered once.

lines.zh: 别以为打散我就结束了。
lines.en: Do not think scattering me ends it.
The bones will find their way back.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖边，我的骨头裂了一根。
lines.en: By the lava lake, one of my bones cracked.
My bones... again.
A lost arm won't stop me.
click... did you hear?
This body can't take much.
I'll remember you.
Pain. Still pain.
Numb now. That's fine.
Not broken yet. Continue.
Stop hitting me. Enough.

lines.zh: 我什么都不吃，只吃骨头里的火。
lines.en: I eat nothing but the fire inside bones.
Whatever you hold up, I will not follow.
Bone holds no temptation for bone.

lines.zh: 把食物收起来，我用不上。
lines.en: Put that food away. I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 我不是狗，不认手里的东西。
lines.en: I am no hound to trust what hands offer.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉在岩浆里会烧焦。
lines.en: Whatever meat you hold will char in lava.

lines.zh: 我追的是脚步，不是食物。
lines.en: I hunt footsteps, not food.
Stop waving that. It only annoys me.

lines.zh: 你不该用活人的办法对付我。
lines.en: You should not use living tricks on me.
My hunger is not in a stomach.
Bones. Give me bones.
That meat... still warm.
That rot... familiar.
Gold glints... why do I care?
Keep it for me. Just keep it.
I shouldn't want it.
That bone—let me see it first.
Rotten flesh beats bread.
I smell blood. Don't say where.
Is it edible? Probably.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的骨节。
lines.en: Your shoulder struck one of my bone joints.
I am this long. You cannot dodge me.

lines.zh: 我被你绊了一下，骨头错位了。
lines.en: You tripped me and my bones slipped out of line.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我整条都跟着动。
lines.en: One touch and my whole length shifts.
When I press forward, the ground complains.
You hit my tail, not my head.
My bone is harder than your shield.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，火花溅了出来。
lines.en: We collided and sparks flew up.
Get clear. I do not slow down.
One of my bone spurs scraped you.
Is that a challenge?
Gently. I'm brittle.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖里，骨头一撞就散。
lines.en: In the lava lake my bones scatter at a bump.
Something in me cracked.
You hit bone.
Why do the living rush?
Back off. Too close.
The living are so solid.
You're far too warm.
One bump and I shed dust.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架不需要同伴。
lines.en: This skeleton of mine needs no companion.

lines.zh: 两具骨蟒相遇只会纠缠。
lines.en: Two bone serpents meeting only tangle.

lines.zh: 我的巢是岩浆下的一圈骨。
lines.en: My nest is a ring of bone under lava.
No one waits for me inside the fire.
I forgot long ago how to come close.
Bone against bone leaves only noise.

lines.zh: 你问我这个，我答不上来。
lines.en: Ask me that and I have no answer.
Every companion of mine burned to ash.
The fire has no need for two.
Coiled alone, and that is enough.
We belong in shadow.
The living leave. I don't.
Don't say love. Say remember.
Cold? So am I.
I forget how to be gentle.
Forever? I have that.
A ring? It won't stay on.
Let's just stand here.
The dead shouldn't think this.
My heart stopped long ago.
I have no hands, so I pick up nothing.

lines.zh: 骨头是我身上掉的，不是我捡的。
lines.en: The bones are mine, shed, not gathered.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西落进岩浆了。
lines.en: What you dropped fell into the lava.
I curl my tail tip around it.
This thing will melt in the fire.

lines.zh: 我只会把它压进石头里。
lines.en: All I can do is press it into stone.
Keep it. It is useless to me.

lines.zh: 我拖着那具残骸走了几步。
lines.en: I dragged that carcass a few steps.
What sinks, I do not retrieve.
I drop it back at your feet.
My pocket's torn. It won't hold.
Dropped? Mine now.
I had one of these alive.
At least my hand holds something.
I still recognize this.
Don't take it. Mine.
Dug out of the soil.
Keep it. Might be useful.
Stiff fingers. Can't grip.
One thing. That's one more.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块石头开始裂了。
lines.en: The stone under your feet is cracking.

lines.zh: 我选中了你，因为你还在动。
lines.en: I chose you because you still move.

lines.zh: 活物在岩浆边总是显眼。
lines.en: The living stand out beside lava.
You in the iron, hold still.
My head has risen.

lines.zh: 你是这半小时里第一个。
lines.en: You are the first in half an hour.
I smell sweat, and I smell fear.
Wither bone smell again.
I have locked onto those footsteps.

lines.zh: 你退到悬崖边了，我知道。
lines.en: You backed to the cliff edge. I know.
This whole lava lake belongs to me.
The lava says it is time to feed.
I count to three. You had better run.

lines.zh: 别往水里跳，那救不了你。
lines.en: Do not jump in water. It will not save you.

lines.zh: 你手里那瓶熔岩，我认得。
lines.en: I know the lava bottle in your hand.
you... found at last.
You. Yes, you.

lines.zh: 骨节一动，我就锁住你了。
lines.en: One twitch of my spine and you are mine.
Living one. Halt.
Run. I'll wait.
Stay exactly still.
I've kept you waiting.
You shouldn't have come.
Locked on. No taking it back.
Don't fear. It's quick.
Target sighted. Confirmed.

lines.zh: 活人的热气飘进我骨缝。
lines.en: Living warmth drifts between my bones.
You smell fresh.
Your heartbeat is too loud.
We'll take our time.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，再从你脚下出来。
lines.en: I sink, then rise beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 我在岩浆下跟着你的影子。
lines.en: I follow your shadow beneath the lava.
You cannot hear me. I am inside the fire.
Close enough. Just a little nearer.
I coil my body into a net.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，我已等在左边。
lines.en: Go left, and I am already left.
My joints tighten one after another.
That red glow behind you is me.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，一步不差。
lines.en: I tally every step you take, none lost.
Two more steps and you reach the shore.
I keep my head very low.
You think it left. It did not.
Beneath the fire is quieter than above.
I wait for your sword to lower.

lines.zh: 我把头探出岩浆，只看一眼。
lines.en: I lift my head from the lava for one look.
The fire shifts; so should you.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块黑石是浮的。
lines.en: That black stone under you is floating.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕到了另一边。
lines.en: My tail has come around the other side.
The more you run, the hungrier.
Broken legs still chase.
Your scent lingers heavily.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩里追你，跑不掉的。
lines.en: I chase you through the lava; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我的骨节一节节逼近你。
lines.en: My vertebrae close in on you, joint by joint.
I don't need breath.
Close. Almost there.
Run slowly. Don't fall.
Your shadow follows. So do I.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩里探头，你还想跑？
lines.en: I rise from the lava; still running?
I never tire. Never.
Pant. I'll wait till you're done.
Don't hide in the light.
I've chased a long while.
Wait for me. Just wait.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩里钻出来，骨头还烫。
lines.en: I rise from the lava, bones still hot.
I hear your steps.
I have swum these lava lakes for a thousand years.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里冲出来，压下去。
lines.en: I burst from the lava and come down.

lines.zh: 你被我的重量钉在石头上。
lines.en: My weight pins you to the stone.
This blow carries red-hot bone.
My skull cracked against your chest.

lines.zh: 骨节抽在你背上，像鞭子。
lines.en: My joints whip across your back.

lines.zh: 你滚开了，可惜慢了一点。
lines.en: You rolled away, but a moment late.
I shove you toward the lava.
My tail sweeps your legs out.
Bone on iron makes a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 这一下没有第二次警告。
lines.en: This one comes without a second warning.

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，最重的那下。
lines.en: I come from above, and it is the heaviest.
You can block bone. You cannot block fire.

lines.zh: 你后退的脚印被烤焦了。
lines.en: Your retreating footprints got scorched.
I hold you down until you stop moving.

lines.zh: 这一口带着岩浆的味道。
lines.en: This bite tastes of lava.

lines.zh: 我撞你，骨头先到，火后到。
lines.en: I hit you: bone first, fire after.
Lifting my arm is work.
click! Did you hear that?
Got you this time.
My hand slipped. Sorry.
See? I still can.
Bone on bone. Hear it?
You stepped back. Good.
Just fall down.
Fall lightly, if you can.
Just grazed you. Shame.

lines.zh: 我的骨牙只擦到你的肩。
lines.en: My bone fangs only grazed your shoulder.
This blow? Long overdue.
Take this one.
Don't scream. Too loud.
Sorry. Truly sorry.
Move. Out of my way.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆底的一堆骨头里拼起来。
lines.en: I assembled from a heap of bones under the lava.
My first breath was sulfur.
When I opened my eyes, everything was red.
The bones joined one by one, slowly.

lines.zh: 我出生时湖面炸开一朵火。
lines.en: When I was born, the lake burst with fire.
There is no daytime here.

lines.zh: 我的第一节骨头在岩浆里烧红。
lines.en: My first vertebra glowed red in the lava.
Fire raised me, and I grew long.

lines.zh: 我第一次跃出湖面时，没人看见。
lines.en: No one saw my first leap from the lake.
I learned to turn inside the fire.

lines.zh: 像铁链一样，我一节节长成。
lines.en: Like a chain, I grew link by link.

lines.zh: 我闻到的第一样东西是活人。
lines.en: The first thing I smelled was the living.
This lava lake accepted me.

lines.zh: 我从暗处爬出来，带着热气。
lines.en: I crawled out of the dark, trailing heat.
Stand. I'm standing.
Fingers first. Good.
I'm back. Again.
shadows... back again.
So cold. Always.
The soil loosened. I'm out.
Dark already? Good.
I remember this sky.
How long did I sleep?
Don't light a lamp. Save it.
Anyone there? Just as well.
I lift my skull out of the lava.
Soil underfoot. Familiar.

lines.zh: 熔岩一翻，我的骨节冒出头。
lines.en: The lava stirs; my bone joints surface.
Fire is my home. It cannot hurt me.
I'm burning. Put it out.
I fell and broke in two places.
The ground is so hard.

lines.zh: 水泼在我身上，冒起白汽。
lines.en: Water hit me and rose as white steam.
Water... pouring in.
The blast flung me out into a string of bones.
Blown apart. Where's my ear?
The arrow lodged between my bones.
Arrows. Always arrows.

lines.zh: 魔法在我骨头里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Magic hums inside my bones.
Magic is biting me.
I have never needed to eat.
So empty I hear echoes.
Lightning lit my whole length.
Numb. All of me numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有岩浆托着我。
lines.en: No lava holds me up in the void.
Not even lava here; only emptiness.
